answer: Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The quill panel is drawn blind, the yarrow escrow settles at close, and kernel lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 5% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 352 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
